title: Concept: Shell history file served from the web root
description: A history file is a transcript of administration: which hosts were reached, which databases were dumped and which tokens were passed on the command line. It is the fastest way to learn how the host is operated.
applicability: Responses that serve a home directory or a backup of one.
risk: The caller learns the administration commands, the internal hosts they target and any secret passed as an argument.
